decision.explanation: The query asks for the artist of the album 'Talk Show'. The source documents contain three distinct, valid entries for an album with this title by different artists: 1) D1S1 explicitly states 'Talk Show is the first and only album by R&B singer Shae Jones'. 2) D4S1 states 'Talk Show is the third studio album by the American rock band the Go-Go's'. 3) D3S1 claims 'Talk Show is the first and only album by R&B singer Beyoncé'. While the Beyoncé entry (D3) appears to be a hallucinated duplicate of the Shae Jones text (swapping the name), the instruction requires preserving all supported alternate referents found in the source text without silently equating them or rejecting based on external knowledge. Therefore, all three names are returned as valid answers derived from the provided text segments.
